extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.17.6 - A title's context menu is just Play, Information, Show Playable Streams, Mark as watched and Add to (or Remove from) watchlist. On BingeTV, Music and Live TV have their own Home rows: Kodi's music library, Live TV channels, channel groups and recordings, or a folder of any add-on. v0.17.5 - Profiles: the profile picker shows each profile's picture. On BingeTV it also adds a profile in one go (a name, one of 20 film avatars, and optionally this profile's Stremio add-ons, Home rows and Live TV set-up; it then asks for its own MDBList key), changes a profile's picture and turns "Who's watching?" at start-up on or off. v0.17.4 - BingeTV starts faster: Home shows its rows as it opens (kept from last time), and the service waits a moment before starting up so the rows load first. Nothing changes elsewhere.
